stem: What can readers conclude about Hallie based on her father's description of their experience with the crab on the beach?

options.label: F
options.text: She respects the crab's efforts to avoid being captured.

options.label: G
options.text: She realizes that she needs her father's help in order to catch the crab.

options.label: H
options.text: She is not very experienced at catching crabs.

options.label: J
options.text: She thinks that chasing crabs is an activity that families should do together.
